query: Which exogenous policy events (e.g., RTA ratification dates, subsidy reforms, dispute rulings) provide the most credible quasi-random variation to identify causal effects on fisheries?

response.query: Which exogenous policy events (e.g., RTA ratification dates, subsidy reforms, dispute rulings) provide the most credible quasi-random variation to identify causal effects on fisheries?
response.answer: Regional Trade Agreement (RTA) ratification dates and subsidy reform announcements provide credible quasi-random variation for fisheries studies. Dispute rulings also offer useful exogenous shocks.
